plan.form: As soon as + present simple, I'll + base verb
plan.title: فور أن ... سوف

authored.form: As soon as + present simple, I'll + base verb
authored.title: فور أن ... سوف
authored.explanation_ar: يعني حصول الفعل الثاني فور وقوع الأول تقريبًا؛ وبعد as soon as نستخدم المضارع للمعنى المستقبلي.
authored.explanation_en: Use as soon as followed by the simple present for a future action that follows immediately.
authored.contrast_ar: As soon as I arrive أقوى في الفورية من When I arrive.
authored.contrast_en: As soon as emphasizes little or no delay after the first event. In this future-time pattern its clause uses the present simple, not ordinary predictive will.

authored.title: أشعر بـ
authored.explanation_ar: نصف حالتنا الشعورية باستخدام صفة بعد feel، وليس اسمًا بلا أداة مناسبة.
authored.explanation_en: Use I feel with an adjective to describe how you feel now. Feel can describe physical or emotional states.
authored.contrast_ar: I feel tired تصف الحالة؛ I feel like resting تعبر عن الرغبة في فعل شيء.
authored.contrast_en: A linking feel takes an adjective for the state: feel nervous, not feel nervously. Feel like plus -ing instead expresses an inclination to do something.

authored.form: I'm worried about + noun or verb ending in ing
authored.title: أنا قلق بشأن
authored.explanation_ar: نعبر عن القلق بشأن شخص أو أمر باستخدام about يليها اسم أو صيغة ing.
authored.explanation_en: Use worried about to express concern about someone or something.
authored.contrast_ar: I'm worried about the test قلق؛ I'm excited about the test حماس.
authored.contrast_en: About is a preposition, so use a noun or an -ing activity after it. Worried describes the person's concern; worrying can describe something that causes concern.

advanced.explanation_ar: I'm worried about the test قلق؛ I'm excited about the test حماس.
advanced.explanation_en: About is a preposition, so use a noun or an -ing activity after it. Worried describes the person's concern; worrying can describe something that causes concern.
